# TagCache.redis property

Shared `ioredis` connection taken from `RedisCache` at construction time. Absent until `RedisCache.init()` has been awaited, and deleted again by [TagCache.destroy()](/api/tag-cache/latest/tag-cache.tagcache.destroy/) — while it is absent every operation throws a `TypeError` carrying [REDIS\_INIT\_ERROR](/api/tag-cache/latest/tag-cache.redis_init_error/)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
redis?: Redis;
```
